description: This file is a class definition for performing upgrade tasks in the OpenCart system, specifically related to database schema and data modifications during an upgrade to version 13. It contains methods for managing product identifiers, migrating data, and handling errors during the upgrade process.

classes.name: Upgrade13
classes.description: A controller class responsible for executing database upgrade routines specific to version 13, including adding new product identifiers, transforming existing data, and removing deprecated fields.
